script:
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/switch_llm" --auth none --json '{"llm": {"model": "openai/qa-f09-noauth", "usage_id": "qa-f09-noauth"}}' --expect 401 --check detail eq Unauthorized --save F09.auth-required/switch-llm
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/switch_profile" --auth none --json '{"profile_name": "deepseek-pro"}' --expect 401
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/switch_acp_model" --auth bad --json '{"model": "opus"}' --expect 401
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/load_plugin" --auth none --json '{"plugin_ref": "qa-f09-mkt-plugin@qa-f09-mkt"}' --expect 401
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID" --check agent.llm.model eq deepseek/deepseek-flash --check agent.llm.usage_id eq default --quiet
